top_stories.title: Nationals Prefer Short-Term Deals In Search For Rotation Help

why_it_matters.text: The Washington Nationals are seeking starting pitching help but appear to favor short-term deals over major free agent signings. Reports indicate the team has explored the trade market for controllable starters while maintaining a preference for shorter commitments.

top_stories.title: MLB rumors: Mets to meet with Japanese pitcher, plus latest on Cubs, Mariners, Nationals, more

why_it_matters.text: The latest MLB offseason news and rumors include reports of the Mets planning to meet with a Japanese pitcher, along with updates regarding the Cubs, Mariners, and Nationals.

top_stories.title: The Washington Nationals seem unlikely to spend big yet again

why_it_matters.text: An article by Spencer Nusbaum discusses the Washington Nationals' potential pitching targets, noting that the team seems unlikely to spend significantly. The reported targets include Kris Bubic, Brady Singer, and Kona Takahashi.

top_stories.title: Baseball’s Elite Lab is Not Run by Nerds

why_it_matters.text: The article explores modern baseball training facilities, specifically Driveline's lab in Scottsdale, Arizona. It contrasts traditional views of 'baseball nerds' with the reality of high-tech pitching and hitting labs used by professionals today.

top_stories.title: Talented Washington Nationals prospect Gavin Fien will look to bounce back from a down season

why_it_matters.text: Washington Nationals prospect Gavin Fien aims to recover from a disappointing season. Previously considered a key piece in the MacKenzie Gore trade, the 2025 draft's 12th overall pick is recognized for his hitting ability, though his defensive position has remained uncertain.

top_stories.title: Nationals To Sign Hagen Danner To Minor League Deal

why_it_matters.text: The Washington Nationals are signing 28-year-old right-hander Hagen Danner to a minor league deal. Danner previously played in the minors for the Reds and Angels, recording a 6.35 ERA in 37 Triple-A appearances during the 2026 season.
